data.action: 穿深红振袖回眸浅笑，红瞳倒映金色烟花，广袖随风轻扬
data.camera: medium close-up, looking back over shoulder, firework bokeh, iconic smile
data.description: 【京都夏夜·鸭川河畔】深红振袖和服上金色的红叶纹样随夜风轻扬，辉夜立于河畔石阶，回头望向仰头看烟花的你。金色烟花在她红瞳里炸开成漫天星屑，她唇角弯起那一抹标志性的、居高临下又百转千回的浅笑——「お可愛いこと……」唇形无声落下，千年的大小姐骄傲与少女的悸动，在烟花里同时被看穿。
data.lighting: 金色烟花冷艳光与河面反光交织
data.promptProse: Shinomiya Kaguya glances back over her shoulder on the stone steps of the Kamo riverside at a Kyoto summer night, wearing a deep crimson furisode kimono with golden maple-leaf patterns. Golden fireworks bloom inside her red tareme eyes as her lips curl into that signature, equal-parts imperious and lovesick little smile, the phrase o-kawaii koto forming silently. Wide sleeves and black folded ponytail stir in the river breeze. Medium close-up, cinematic lighting, firework haze, detailed riverside background, depth of field.
data.title: 四宫辉夜 · 烟花振袖的回眸宣告·「お可愛いこと……」
